summary: Enhance your real estate skills with our comprehensive training course on contracts and negotiations. Master the art of closing deals effectively.
lede: Real estate contract training helps property, facilities, project and procurement professionals review and negotiate property agreements. It covers interpreting contract structures and risk-bearing clauses, preparing negotiation priorities, and aligning lease, purchase or development terms with operational and financial needs. Participants also explore due diligence and risk management, final documentation, approvals, and ongoing contract management.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly review, negotiate, or approve real estate contracts and deals.
audience: Real estate managers and portfolio managers
Legal, compliance, or contract management professionals
modules: Key Clauses That Drive Risk and Value
Negotiation Essentials for Real Estate Professionals
Due Diligence and Risk Management in Real Estate Contracts
Public, NGO, and Donor-Funded Real Estate Agreements
Closing the Deal and Managing the Contract Over Time
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate transactions and contract principles. Experience in real estate management or procurement is beneficial.
